{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check missing values in flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}')

# Confirm the population: all penguins in the dataset
print(f'Total rows in dataset: {len(df)}')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, using all available data (excluding missing values)
mean_flipper_length = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print('\nMean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_length)"}
